outcome: Childhood allergic diseases (allergic asthma, allergic rhinitis, atopic dermatitis)
cohort: The study included 621 children aged 3-17 years, comprising a group of 371 who received neonatal phototherapy and a control group of 250 who did not.
finding: There was no statistically significant association between neonatal phototherapy treatment and the incidence of childhood asthma, allergic rhinitis, or atopic dermatitis, although the percentage of eosinophilia was significantly higher in the phototherapy group.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more frequent in the control group (p<0.05).
